content: तीर्थम् [तॄ-थक् <ls>Uṇ. 2. 7</ls>] ‘तीर्थं शास्त्राध्वरक्षेत्रोपायोपाध्यायमन्त्रिषु’ इति विश्वः .²1 A passage, road, way, ford; सुप्रतारां दृढां तीर्थे शीघ्रं नावमुपाहर <ls>Rām. 2. 52. 6</ls>; <ls>Bhāg. 9. 19. 4</ls>. .²2 A descent into a river, the stairs of a landing-place (<lang>Mar.</lang> <ns>घाट</ns>); विषमोऽपि विगाह्यते नयः कृततीर्थः पयसामिवाशयः <ls>Ki. 2. 3</ls> (where तीर्थ means ‘a remedy’ or ‘means’ also); तीर्थं सर्वविद्यावताराणाम् <ls>K. 44</ls>. .²3 A place of water. .²4 A holy place, place of pilgrimage, a shrine <ab>&c.</ab> dedicated to some holy object (especially on or near the bank of a sacred river <ab>&c.</ab>); तीर्थोदकं च वह्निश्च नान्यतः शुद्धिमर्हतः <ls>U. 1. 13</ls>; शुचि मनो यद्यस्ति तीर्थेन किम् <ls>Bh. 2. 55</ls>; <ls>R. 1. 85</ls>. .²5 A channel, medium, means; तदनेन तीर्थेन घटेत <ab>&c.</ab> <ls>Māl. 1</ls>. .²6 A remedy, expedient; नाध्यगच्छद्बलिर्लोके तीर्थमन्यत्र वै द्विजात् <ls>Mb. 3. 26. 12</ls>. .²7 A sacred or holy personage, worthy person, an object of veneration, a fit recipient; क्व पुनस्तादृशस्य तीर्थस्य साधोः संभवः <ls>U. 1</ls>; <ls>Ms. 3. 136</ls>; <ls>H. 2. 8</ls>; <ls>R. 5. 15</ls>; वृद्धस्य तीर्थेषु प्रतिपादिनी <ls>Kau. A. 1</ls>. .²8 A sacred preceptor, a teacher; मया तीर्थादभिनयविद्या शिक्षिता <ls>M. 1</ls>. .²9 Source, origin. .²10 A sacrifice. .²11 A minister; <ls>Rām. 2. 100. 36</ls>; <ls>Pt. 3. 68</ls>. .²12 Advice, instruction; विषमोऽपि विगाह्यते नयः कृततीर्थः पयसामिवाशयः <ls>Ki. 2. 3</ls>. .²13 Right place or moment; प्रादात्स्वन्नं च विप्रेभ्यः प्रजातीर्थे स तीर्थवित् <ls>Bhāg. 1. 12. 14</ls>. .²14 The right or usual manner; गौतम तीर्थेनेच्छासा इत्युपैम्यहं भवन्तम् <ls>Bṛ. Up. 6. 2. 7</ls>. .²15 Certain parts of the hand sacred to deities, manes <ab>&c.</ab> .²16 A school of philosophy. .²17 Pudendum muliebre. .²18 Menstrual courses of a woman. .²19 A Brāhmaṇa. .²20 (In liturgical language) The path to the altar between the चात्वाल <ab>q. v.</ab> and उत्कर <ab>q. v.</ab> .²21 Fire. .²22 Ascertainment of a disease. .²23 A science (शास्त्र). .²24 An auxiliary, a help; a person or official connected with the king and being in close attendance on him; (the number being 15 on oneʼs side and 18 on the enemyʼs side); <ab>cf.</ab> <ls>Pt. 3. 69</ls>. .{@-र्थः@} One of the ten orders of ascetics founded by शंकराचार्य, An honorary affix added to the names of ascetics, saints <ab>&c.</ab>; {%<ab>e. g.</ab>%} आनन्दतीर्थ. --{%a.%} .²1 Sacred. .²2 Liberator, saviour; वार्तां सखे कीर्तय तीर्थकीर्तेः <ls>Bhāg. 3. 1. 45</ls>.
